title: Split and perpendicular characters
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$, and choose a linear isomorphism from $H\times\mathbb F_2^d$ to $\mathbb F_2^n$ for some dimension $d$, whose restriction to the first factor agrees with the inclusion of $H$. A sign character obtained by taking a dot product with a frequency in the complementary coordinates is exactly a character whose frequency lies in the perpendicular subspace $H^\perp$; equivalently, a function is representable in the chosen split-character form if and only if it is representable as $z\mapsto(-1)^{\eta\cdot z}$ for some $\eta\in H^\perp$.
hypotheses_covered: A complementary dimension $d$ and linear isomorphism $H\times\mathbb F_2^d\cong\mathbb F_2^n$ compatible with the inclusion of $H$
